text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A light aircraft which plunged into Lake Kariba killing four people on Sunday is suspected to have experienced engine problems just before the accident.

- Efforts by cattle producers to rebuild the national herd which has dwindled to critical levels over the past few years are slowly gaining momentum following the unveiling last week of a Z$100 million loan facility by Barclays Bank.
- Parirenyatwa Hospital, Zimbabwe's largest referral health care centre, is owed more than Z$27 million in unpaid hospital fees spanning over four years.
